title: Lübeck Altstadt und Umgebung
status: Illustrative pixel-art map from open geodata; 0.4 m tiles, landmarks repainted and reviewed
limitations: Facades have no measured evidence; brick walls and windows are illustrative.

Holstentor, Rathaus, Markt, Katharinenkirche, Burgtor and Salzspeicher were repainted individually; their details are illustrative. The Rathaus repaint used a public-domain photo (Blick auf Rathaus Luebeck.jpg) as a second reference.
Shorelines follow the DOP20 near-infrared band where OSM water polygons were off.
Roof colours follow OSM tags; OSM's default copper #33CC99 is shown as patina.
Allotment gardens are painted as green plots; individual garden houses are illustrative.
